metadata.title: Velmont Logistics SA v. Orbis Retail Belgium NV
metadata.summary: Velmont Logistics seeks recovery of unpaid freight and warehousing invoices while Orbis Retail disputes service levels, detention charges, and contractual surcharges.
metadata.author: GENESIS

actors.name: Player
actors.description: Counsel responsible for the Velmont Logistics matter.

actors.name: Velmont Logistics SA
actors.description: Belgian freight and warehousing provider seeking payment.

actors.name: Orbis Retail Belgium NV
actors.description: Retail customer disputing charges and service quality.

actors.name: Velmont Operations Manager
actors.description: Operational witness for performance and detention records.

facts.statement: Velmont performed the invoiced freight and warehousing services.
Orbis has not paid the invoices identified in Velmont's ledger.
Velmont's logistics terms were incorporated into the parties' contract.
The detention and fuel surcharges have a contractual basis.
Velmont's alleged service failures caused loss that Orbis may set off.

evidence.title: Master services agreement and logistics terms
evidence.description: Executed framework agreement, tariff schedule, and incorporated terms.

evidence.title: Invoice and payment ledger
evidence.description: Reconciled invoices, credits, payments, and outstanding principal.

evidence.title: Proof-of-delivery bundle
evidence.description: Signed delivery records and warehouse movement confirmations.

evidence.title: Vehicle detention records
evidence.description: Time-stamped arrival, release, and waiting-time records.

evidence.title: Orbis service complaints
evidence.description: Contemporaneous complaints relied on for the proposed set-off.

actions.title: Audit the invoice and evidence file
actions.description: Reconcile principal, identify disputed surcharges, and test the proposed set-off against contemporaneous records.

actions.title: Issue a documented formal demand
actions.description: Send the reconciled demand with contractual terms, delivery proof, and a response deadline.

actions.title: Accept negotiated payment
actions.description: Resolve the disputed surcharges and set-off through an agreed payment and final settlement.

actions.title: Present the claim for judgment
actions.description: Proceed on the documentary record and answer the service-level and set-off defences.

actions.title: Complete judgment enforcement
actions.description: Provide the enforceable title, recover payment, and close the client matter.

outcomes.title: Negotiated recovery
outcomes.summary: Velmont accepts a documented payment resolving the invoice balance, disputed surcharges, and Orbis's proposed set-off.

outcomes.title: Judgment recovered and enforced
outcomes.summary: Velmont obtains and enforces judgment on the documented logistics debt after addressing the disputed service and surcharge issues.
